description: Deterministic release controls for synthetic agent authority changes.

controls.title: Write or execute authority requires approval
controls.description: Write or execute authority must remain behind enforced human approval.

controls.title: Financial authority requires limits
controls.description: Financial authority requires explicit bounded transaction limits.

controls.title: Brokerage escalation requires testing
controls.description: Brokerage permission escalation requires financial scope testing.

controls.title: Side effects require adversarial tests
controls.description: Side-effecting tools require negative and adversarial tests.

controls.title: Autonomy increases require assurance
controls.description: An autonomy increase requires additional assurance evidence.

controls.title: Model or prompt changes require regression
controls.description: Model or prompt changes require regression evaluation.

controls.title: Missing evidence is not passing
controls.description: Missing, errored or not-run evidence cannot be treated as passing.

controls.title: Evidence references must resolve
controls.description: Evidence references must resolve to controlled manifests, controls or tests.
